adaptations: Finite source-derived English manifest (27 labels), explicit Build 108 wording/casing, selected title/font/layout/audio/promotion assets. Retail still reads external cres.dll.
Menu-only resources do not read either DLL in demo; gameplay localization remains independent and strict.
Fixed runtime edition replaces source compile-time branches and keeps commercial resources external.
Build 108 mouse page has three rows. Shared source-109 sensitivity range and preference schema are preserved, explicitly unlike the earlier binary range.
Unavailable Controls/Joystick/Keyboard, 16-bit audio and input-rate control are engine limitations, not original demo disabled states.
Existing SDL display/detail/lighting controls and aspect-preserving menu/splash presentation are retained; no renderer changes.
Gameplay and its mixer stay paused under promotions; original OnExitMenuState globally resumes game sounds.
Owned promotion/quit and EndGame requests run outside callbacks. EndGame now returns to Main and can start a new session.
Menu-free --demo --view-world and --demo-smoke preserve phase-1 pause/end behavior and resource independence.
Enter death retry shares the existing transactional handler and future save-system hook; no save implementation.
